why: This is a study-developed assessment instrument that can be adopted to measure sepsis-recognition knowledge, attitudes, and practices, rather than a general instructional element.
name: 53-item KAP survey instrument with two scenario-based vignettes for sepsis recognition
product_description: A self-administered 53-item knowledge, attitudes, and practices questionnaire for pre-hospital emergency medical care practitioners, developed by the study authors through literature synthesis, expert review, and pilot testing.
